note: Real quotes only, each with where it was said. Checked against the sourced sections of Wikiquote in November 2026. Add more in the same shape; never add a quote without a source.

quotes.text: When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.
If a schedule is long, it's wrong. If it's tight, it's right.
Undesigning is the best thing. Just delete it.
If nothing else, we are committed to failing in a new way.
It takes 20 years to build a reputation and five minutes to ruin it.
quotes.source: Widely cited remark, in print by 2005

quotes.text: We don't get paid for activity, just for being right.
Someone's sitting in the shade today because someone planted a tree a long time ago.
When forced to choose, I will not trade even a night's sleep for the chance of extra profits.
If you have a really good idea, stick to it, but be flexible on how you get there.
Success is a lousy teacher. It seduces smart people into thinking they can't lose.
One thing is certain in business. You and everyone around you will make mistakes.
Don't ever be afraid to ask for help.
Instead of letting your hardships and failures discourage or exhaust you, let them inspire you.
What I know for sure is you become what you believe.
